title: Overlord: Ple Ple Pleiades
justification: AniList 21305 (SPECIAL, 8 episode(s) from 2015-08-04) is AniDB 10816's special(s) S1-S8, aired 2015-08-04 to 2015-09-22. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10816. TVDB 294002 season 0 episodes 1-8 carry the same titles and the same dates; the parent node has no row for S1-S8, so the default S0E<n> is already the right place.
